description.fun: A centipede with a built-in radiator: it stores flammable gas in its body to heat itself up, and the yellow rings on its belly get especially hot. It wraps prey in its coils to cook them, then nibbles every last morsel once they're well done. It shares a common ancestor with Skorupi, and fights Venipede whenever they meet.
description.guide: A small Fire and Bug-type centipede Pokémon that heats its body with flammable gas stored inside, designed by James Turner. Sizzlipede coils around prey to cook it. It evolves into Centiskorch.
description.tagline: A centipede that cooks its prey in its own coils

description.fun: A belligerent fire centipede that attacks anything that comes near, lashing its searing body like a whip and backing it up with large, sharp fangs. It feuds with Scolipede, and whichever wins the territorial fight gets to eat the other. Its design may draw on the Ōmukade, a giant centipede from Japanese myth whose legs were said to shine like torches.
description.guide: The evolution of Sizzlipede, a long, aggressive Fire and Bug-type centipede whose body heats up to about 800 °C. It has a Gigantamax form, the tallest Gigantamax form of all.
description.tagline: A hostile fire centipede that whips foes with its body

description.fun: Grows to 100 legs and more than 75 metres long, the tallest of all Gigantamax forms, with a body hotter than 1,000 °C whose heat waves can stir up storms. James Turner designed it, down to its attack pose.
